cohort_summary: Game-market bettors find Pitch Hawk's Home slate fast and legible (WP, total pick, projected runs, strongest read per row) and the expanded game drawer usefully puts weather/wind/roof/ump/park in one grid, with home/away batter tabs, batting-order sort and starter O/U lines. But nothing is priced: win prob shows only the favourite as a %, with no fair American odds, no market line, no no-vig implied prob and no edge, even though Kalshi/ESPN odds and /edge/{pk} exist server-side. Markets this cohort lives on — F5, NRFI/YRFI, team totals, run line — are absent despite team-run means (mu_home/mu_away) already being computed. Every total shows 8.5 with unclear provenance, and the live total keeps a cashed 8.5 line. Game detail is an accordion on Home, not a page; the starter matchup is two last names with pregame form cells as dashes; there is no bullpen state (the model assumes a league-average pen) and no lineup news. Navigating game -> its props works only one way (Open game ›); WP/Total cells are inert, batter names in the pill aren't links, and Predictions has no game filter. Pros use it as a second-opinion number at best; amateurs like the weather grid and readability but can't tell if a % beats their price.

Opens TOR@CLE Starters tab on phone — cards show Ks/Outs O/U; form stats dashes.
Looks for bullpen or innings-limit info to judge F5 — none.
Leaves to an Action Network article.
personas.quote: The guide taught me what lift means, but there's nothing for the first five innings.

pain_points.title: No F5, NRFI/YRFI, team totals or run line
pain_points.detail: F5 and NRFI absent.
pain_points.evidence: frontend/pitchhawk.js:864 PRED_MARKETS = hit/hr/hrr/wp/tot/sp only; grep for nrfi/f5/run line/team_total in frontend returns nothing; game-predict/index.ts:629-641 already computes mu_home/mu_away team-run means and an alpha that are stored in probs but never shown
pain_points.suggested_fix: Expose team totals from mu_home/mu_away immediately; add F5 ML/total and NRFI from a 1st-inning/5-inning split of the same run model; add run line (-1.5) from the run-diff distribution. Add them as chips next to Win prob / Totals.

pain_points.title: Starter matchup is two last names; SP form columns are dashes pregame
pain_points.detail: Starter cards pregame show dashes.
pain_points.evidence: Meta grid 'PROBABLE STARTERS Henderson · Harper' (frontend/pitchhawk.js:2409); Starters tab 30D K%, WHIFF, HR/PA, FB VELO, FATIGUE all '—' for TOR@CLE (frontend/pitchhawk.js:2588); no handedness, season ERA/xFIP, pitch mix, days rest
pain_points.suggested_fix: Make the starter matchup a side-by-side card at the top of game detail: hand, season + 30d K%, BB%, xFIP, HR/9, avg IP, pitch count last start, days rest, team splits vs hand; link names to the starter overlay (ovStarter).

pain_points.title: No bullpen usage/fatigue anywhere; model assumes league-average pen
pain_points.detail: Can't tell when the pen enters.
pain_points.evidence: supabase/functions/_shared/model.ts:404 'the bullpen behind him is assumed league-average'; game detail meta grid frontend/pitchhawk.js:2391 has no bullpen cell
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add a Bullpen block to game detail: relievers' pitches last 3 days, availability flags, pen xFIP/K-BB 30d, and say in the win-prob tooltip that pen is league-average until modelled.

delights: Guide/glossary is approachable.
BASE tags make clear which numbers are placeholders.

personas.name: Ray Donnelly
personas.profile: AMATEUR · $2k roll, $20 unit · DraftKings, Hard Rock · bets totals and checks lineups before locking
personas.goal: Wait for lineups on NYM@WSH (pending) and see how the total/WP changes once posted.
journey: Home: 'lineups confirmed 6/7' header; NYM@WSH row says 'LINEUP PENDING'. Good.
Opens pill: CLE-style batter list with 'lineup pending' note.
Wants to know if a star is sitting and how much the total will move — no lineup news, no scratch flags.
Refreshes later; WP/total change but no 'changed because of lineup' marker; can't tell what moved.
No alert option for 'lineup posted' on a game (alerts are batter at-bat / swings).
personas.quote: Tell me who sat and how much it moved the number — a ✓ isn't news.

pain_points.title: Lineup status is a flag, not news
pain_points.detail: Lineup status is a binary flag with no change attribution.
pain_points.evidence: 'LINEUP ✓ / LINEUP PENDING' caption (frontend/pitchhawk.js:2297); no scratches, injuries, rest days, catcher, or time of lineup post; model re-score time shown only as 'updated 5:06 PM'
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add a lineup panel per team with confirmed order, changes vs typical (who sat), posting time, and 'model re-scored after lineup at HH:MM' with the WP/total delta that the lineup caused.

pain_points.title: No alert when a watched game's lineup posts or line moves
pain_points.detail: Alerts cover pinned batters coming up and big live swings only (copy.js:41)
pain_points.evidence: copy.js:41 alertsOnTip
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add 'notify on lineup posted / model total moved >0.3 R / WP moved >3 pts' for starred games.

pain_points.title: Total line source unclear; every game shows 8.5
pain_points.detail: Line source unknown.
pain_points.evidence: Home pill 'O 8.5' on all 7 games; frontend/pitchhawk.js:2752 totPickOf uses mkt.line with no provenance; scripts/dev_mock_api.py:79 line 8.5
pain_points.suggested_fix: Label the line's source and timestamp (e.g. 'DK 8.5 o-110 · 4:58 PM' vs 'model default 8.5'), and show P(over) at the actual market line plus alternate lines (7.5/8/9).

delights: 'lineups confirmed 6/7' in the header is a smart at-a-glance status.
Pregame reads re-score until lineup locks, and the footer says so.

top_cohort_issues.title: Win prob / total show no market price, implied prob or edge
top_cohort_issues.fix: Fetch /edge/{pk} and render per side: market ML (book + timestamp), no-vig implied %, model %, edge pts, EV per $100; colour the chip by edge, not by favourite.

top_cohort_issues.title: Starter matchup is two last names; SP form columns are dashes pregame
top_cohort_issues.fix: Make the starter matchup a side-by-side card at the top of game detail: hand, season + 30d K%, BB%, xFIP, HR/9, avg IP, pitch count last start, days rest, team splits vs hand; link names to the starter overlay (ovStarter).

top_cohort_issues.title: Total line source unclear; every game shows 8.5
top_cohort_issues.fix: Label the line's source and timestamp (e.g. 'DK 8.5 o-110 · 4:58 PM' vs 'model default 8.5'), and show P(over) at the actual market line plus alternate lines (7.5/8/9).

top_cohort_issues.title: Model % never converted to fair American odds
top_cohort_issues.fix: Show fair line beside every probability (57% -> -133 / +133) and a toggle for American/decimal; show both sides, not just the favourite.

top_cohort_issues.title: Win prob chip shows only the favourite's side
top_cohort_issues.fix: Render both teams (TOR 43% +133 | CLE 57% -133) so dog bettors can read their side directly.

top_cohort_issues.title: No line movement, open/close or CLV tracking
top_cohort_issues.fix: Store market snapshots per game; show open -> now -> close sparkline beside model fair, and grade picks by CLV in the Scorecard.

top_cohort_issues.title: Weather/park/ump shown as raw facts, not run impact
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add impact numbers: 'wind +0.4 R', 'park +3% runs', 'ump: 52% overs, +0.3 K/9 over 3y', and show how much each moved the projected total.

top_cohort_issues.title: Phone game detail is a very long scroll with batters before lines
top_cohort_issues.fix: On phone, open a full-screen game sheet with sticky header (ML/total/fair odds) and segmented tabs Lines | Pitchers | Lineups | Props.

top_cohort_issues.title: Hard to go from a game to all its props and back
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add 'All props for TOR @ CLE ›' in the game detail that routes to #/pred?game=<pk>; add a game filter chip on Predictions; make batter names open the player overlay; add 'Back to game' breadcrumb.

top_cohort_issues.title: No bullpen usage/fatigue anywhere; model assumes league-average pen
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add a Bullpen block to game detail: relievers' pitches last 3 days, availability flags, pen xFIP/K-BB 30d, and say in the win-prob tooltip that pen is league-average until modelled.

top_cohort_issues.title: Live total keeps the pregame 8.5 line once it is decided
top_cohort_issues.fix: Re-anchor the live total to the live market line (or show P(over) at current runs + n), and suppress lines already decided.

top_cohort_issues.title: Lineup status is a flag, not news
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add a lineup panel per team with confirmed order, changes vs typical (who sat), posting time, and 'model re-scored after lineup at HH:MM' with the WP/total delta that the lineup caused.

top_cohort_issues.title: No track record for win prob / totals
top_cohort_issues.fix: Show season-long Brier/log-loss and ROI vs closing line for ML and totals, by confidence bucket, linked from the chips.

top_cohort_issues.title: Live tab is pitch/at-bat centric; game-line trader gets a small rail
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add a 'Game lines' mode on Live: big WP chart with market overlay, live total distribution, next-half-inning run probs.

top_cohort_issues.title: No alert when a watched game's lineup posts or line moves
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add 'notify on lineup posted / model total moved >0.3 R / WP moved >3 pts' for starred games.

top_cohort_issues.title: Win prob / Total cells on Home rows are inert
top_cohort_issues.fix: Make the WP cell open the win-prob chart/edge breakdown and the Total cell open the run distribution (P(over) at 7.5..10.5, team totals).

top_cohort_issues.title: No game page — game detail is an inline accordion on Home
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add a #/game/<pk> page: header with lines + fair odds, SP matchup, bullpen, lineups, weather/park/ump, then tabs for game markets, batter props, starter props, live.
